title: Lantern & Quill: autumn courses and a shelf of new arrivals
preheaderText: New evening courses, three fresh titles on the shelf, and the people who pick them. Come read with us this season.
heroImageAlt: A lit reading lamp over a stack of coloured books and a quill
heroHeadline: An open mind, one page at a time
heroText: New evening courses just went up, and the shelves are heavy with autumn arrivals. Pull up a chair by the lamp; there is a lot to get into this season.
quoteText: The purpose of an education is to replace an empty mind with an open one.
product1Text: A season of nature writing, bound in cloth. Signed first printing.
product2Text: Collected correspondence, newly translated. Paperback edition.
ctaText: One short letter a week: a new title, a course opening, and a page worth marking. No noise, unsubscribe any time.
legalText: Lantern & Quill is a fictitious brand used as sample content in an open-source HTML email compatibility framework. See github.com/dcondrey/html-email for details.
